messages.content: তুমি কি মনে করো আমি খুব বেশি sensitive মানুষদের কথায়?
Depend kore actually context er upor - kader kotha, ki bishoy niye? Sensitivity always bad na, kintu selectively kar kotha value dicho sheta matter kore.
mostly amar family er kotha, tara ekta kotha bolle shara din mon kharap thake
Family er kotha beshi lage honestly karon stakes onno rokom - kintu daily mood spoil howa mane eta actual boundary er dorkar hote pare.
kivabe boundary set korbo family er sathe eta niye?
Direct bola shobcheye effective - 'ei kothata amake affect kore, ektu different bhabe bolo' emon kichu। Actually family der bujhano lage j eta cruelty na, self-protection.
